prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1016; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss by phone from the insured driver. Reports a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road, with the other vehicle moving into the same lane. Both vehicles drivable. Insured reports neck and shoulder discomfort at scene but declined transport. Photos requested from insured and scene location noted in file.

Entry 2: Contacted the third-party driver. Driver disputes lane change fault and states the insured drifted over. Obtained statements from both drivers and requested any available dashcam footage. No independent witnesses identified so far. Liability remains under review.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received and logged. All further communication to be directed through counsel. Claimant's reported injury is a shoulder injury; medical authorization forms sent to the attorney's office for signature. Recorded that the claimant is currently under evaluation by an orthopedic provider.

Entry 4: Reviewed property damage estimates on both vehicles. Repair shop inspection scheduled. Rental coverage confirmed for the insured under the policy. Attorney's office notified of the vehicle inspection and asked whether the claimant's medical records will be provided ahead of the next file review.

Entry 5: Received partial medical records through counsel, including initial imaging and physical therapy notes referencing the shoulder injury. Records forwarded to the medical review desk for evaluation. Liability decision still pending dashcam review. Diary set for follow-up with counsel in two weeks.
